_disclaimer: Author-written for this evaluation (not official Samsung/SIIS content, not copied from the official held-out sets). Queries are grouped by the official-data-cached plan title they are intended to represent, ONLY where a warmed plan for that title actually exists in this repository's data (see tests/test_retrieval_evaluation_145.py, which loads the live catalog/SIIS rows and asserts every 'expected_title' below is a real cached title before scoring anything). Two official rows currently exist in data/original/siis_responses.json but are gated by the relevance filter and never enter the cache: row_16 (rapid screen flashing while charging) and row_20 (visual distortion after receiving the phone). Because of that, queries about charger-triggered flashing or pure visual distortion have NO supported mapping today and are placed in the ambiguous/no_match_expected groups rather than guessed into a plan that doesn't actually cover them.
